WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "s".cdscode, "s".school, "s".gsserved, "s".charter, "f"."Free Meal Count (K-12)" / "f"."Enrollment (K-12)" AS "free_meal_rate" FROM "schools" AS "s" INNER JOIN "frpm" AS "f" ON "f".cdscode = "s".cdscode WHERE "s".county = 'Alameda' AND "s".eilname = 'High School' AND "s".gsserved IS NOT NULL AND "s".gsserved ~ '(^|[^0-9])12($|[^0-9])' AND "f"."Free Meal Count (K-12)" IS NOT NULL), "ranked" AS (SELECT *, MAX(free_meal_rate) OVER () AS "max_rate" FROM "eligible") SELECT "r".school, ROUND("r".free_meal_rate::NUMERIC, 4) AS "free_meal_rate", CASE WHEN "r".charter = 1 THEN 'Yes' WHEN "r".charter = 0 THEN 'No' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS "charter_school", "r".gsserved AS "grades_served", CASE WHEN "sat".avgscrread IS NULL OR "sat".avgscrmath IS NULL OR "sat".avgscrwrite IS NULL THEN 'No SAT Data' WHEN "sat".avgscrread + "sat".avgscrmath + "sat".avgscrwrite < 1200 THEN 'Below Average' WHEN "sat".avgscrread + "sat".avgscrmath + "sat".avgscrwrite <= 1500 THEN 'Average' ELSE 'Above Average' END AS "sat_performance_level" FROM "ranked" AS "r" LEFT JOIN "satscores" AS "sat" ON "sat".cds = "r".cdscode AND "sat".rtype = 'S' WHERE "r".free_meal_rate = "r".max_rate LIMIT 501

WITH "totals" AS (SELECT "c".segment, "ym".customerid, SUM("ym".consumption) AS "total_consumption" FROM "customers" AS "c" INNER JOIN "yearmonth" AS "ym" ON "ym".customerid = "c".customerid WHERE "c".currency = 'CZK' AND CAST("ym".date AS INTEGER) >= 201301 AND CAST("ym".date AS INTEGER) < 201401 GROUP BY "c".segment, "ym".customerid), "minima" AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (segment) segment, customerid, total_consumption FROM "totals" ORDER BY segment ASC, total_consumption ASC, customerid ASC) SELECT ROUND((MAX(total_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'SME') - MAX(total_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'LAM'))::NUMERIC, 2) AS "SME minus LAM", ROUND((MAX(total_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'LAM') - MAX(total_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'KAM'))::NUMERIC, 2) AS "LAM minus KAM", ROUND((MAX(total_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'KAM') - MAX(total_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'SME'))::NUMERIC, 2) AS "KAM minus SME" FROM "minima" LIMIT 501

WITH "yearly" AS (SELECT "c".segment, SUM("y".consumption) FILTER (WHERE "y".date::INTEGER BETWEEN 201201 AND 201212) AS "consumption_2012", SUM("y".consumption) FILTER (WHERE "y".date::INTEGER BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312) AS "consumption_2013" FROM "yearmonth" AS "y" INNER JOIN "customers" AS "c" ON "c".customerid = "y".customerid WHERE "c".currency = 'EUR' AND "c".segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM') GROUP BY "c".segment), "changes" AS (SELECT segment, (consumption_2013 - consumption_2012) * 100.0 / consumption_2012 AS "increase_percentage" FROM "yearly") SELECT segment, ROUND(increase_percentage::NUMERIC, 2) AS "increase_percentage" FROM "changes" WHERE increase_percentage = (SELECT MAX(increase_percentage) FROM "changes") OR increase_percentage = (SELECT MIN(increase_percentage) FROM "changes") ORDER BY increase_percentage DESC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(((SUM(CASE WHEN "y".date::INTEGER / 100 = 2013 THEN "y".consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN "y".date::INTEGER / 100 = 2012 THEN "y".consumption ELSE 0 END)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN "y".date::INTEGER / 100 = 2012 THEN "y".consumption ELSE 0 END), 0))::NUMERIC, 4) AS "relative_change" FROM "yearmonth" AS "y" WHERE "y".customerid = (SELECT "t".customerid FROM "transactions_1k" AS "t" WHERE "t".date = DATE '2012-08-25' AND ABS("t".price::NUMERIC - 634.8) < 0.01) AND "y".date::INTEGER / 100 IN (2012, 2013) LIMIT 501

WITH "active_2012" AS (SELECT DISTINCT customerid FROM "transactions_1k" WHERE date >= DATE '2012-01-01' AND date < DATE '2013-01-01'), "consumption_2012" AS (SELECT customerid, SUM(consumption) AS "total_consumption" FROM "yearmonth" WHERE CAST(date AS INTEGER) >= 201201 AND CAST(date AS INTEGER) < 201301 GROUP BY customerid) SELECT "c".segment, COUNT(*) AS "customer_count" FROM "active_2012" AS "a" INNER JOIN "consumption_2012" AS "y" ON "y".customerid = "a".customerid INNER JOIN "customers" AS "c" ON "c".customerid = "a".customerid WHERE "y".total_consumption < 30000 GROUP BY "c".segment ORDER BY "c".segment ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".segment, COUNT(DISTINCT "c".customerid) AS "customers" FROM "customers" AS "c" INNER JOIN "yearmonth" AS "y" ON "y".customerid = "c".customerid WHERE "y"."date"::INTEGER >= 201301 AND "y"."date"::INTEGER < 201401 AND "y".consumption <> 0 GROUP BY "c".segment LIMIT 501

WITH "monthly" AS (SELECT CAST("date" AS INTEGER) AS "year_month", SUM(consumption::NUMERIC) AS "total_consumption" FROM "yearmonth" WHERE CAST("date" AS INTEGER) >= 201201 AND CAST("date" AS INTEGER) < 201401 GROUP BY CAST("date" AS INTEGER)), "peaks" AS (SELECT year_month / 100 AS "year", MAX(total_consumption) AS "peak_total" FROM "monthly" GROUP BY year_month / 100) SELECT ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2013 THEN peak_total END) - MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2012 THEN peak_total END)) AS "difference" FROM "peaks" LIMIT 501
SELECT ROUND(AVG(consumption)::NUMERIC, 2) FROM "yearmonth" WHERE customerid = 15621 AND "date"::INTEGER >= 201301 AND "date"::INTEGER < 201401 AND consumption > 0 LIMIT 501

WITH "top_districts" AS (SELECT "d".district_id, "d".a2, CAST("d".a16 AS BIGINT) AS "inhabitants" FROM "district" AS "d" ORDER BY CAST("d".a16 AS BIGINT) DESC LIMIT 5), "account_counts" AS (SELECT "a".district_id, COUNT(*) AS "account_count" FROM "account" AS "a" GROUP BY "a".district_id), "loan_totals" AS (SELECT "a".district_id, SUM("l".amount) AS "active_loan_amount" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id AND "l".status IN ('C', 'D') GROUP BY "a".district_id), "averages" AS (SELECT "t".district_id, "t".a2, ROUND(COALESCE("lt".active_loan_amount, 0)::NUMERIC / "ac".account_count)::BIGINT AS "avg_active_loan_per_account" FROM "top_districts" AS "t" INNER JOIN "account_counts" AS "ac" ON "ac".district_id = "t".district_id LEFT JOIN "loan_totals" AS "lt" ON "lt".district_id = "t".district_id) SELECT a2, avg_active_loan_per_account FROM "averages" WHERE avg_active_loan_per_account = (SELECT MAX(avg_active_loan_per_account) FROM "averages") ORDER BY a2 ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "l".amount, "d".a3 AS "region" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "l".date <= DATE '1995-12-31' AND ("l".date + ("l".duration || ' months')::INTERVAL - INTERVAL '1 day')::DATE >= DATE '1995-12-31'), "totals" AS (SELECT region, SUM(amount) AS "total_amount" FROM "eligible" GROUP BY region) SELECT region, total_amount FROM "totals" WHERE total_amount = (SELECT MAX(total_amount) FROM "totals") LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "a".account_id) AS "count" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'north Bohemia' AND "a".date <= DATE '1995-12-31' AND "t".bank = 'AB' LIMIT 501

WITH "qualifying_districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "branch_district".district_id, "branch_district".a11 FROM "district" AS "branch_district" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "branch_district".district_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".account_id = "a".account_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "dp".client_id WHERE "branch_district".a3 = 'east Bohemia' AND "c".birth_date >= DATE '1980-01-01' AND "c".birth_date < DATE '1990-01-01') SELECT ROUND(AVG(a11), 2) AS "average_salary", COUNT(*) AS "number_of_districts" FROM "qualifying_districts" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(district_avg_salary), 2) AS "average_district_salary" FROM (SELECT "d".district_id, AVG("d".a11) AS "district_avg_salary" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".district_id = "d".district_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "owner_disp" ON "owner_disp".client_id = "c".client_id AND "owner_disp".type = 'OWNER' WHERE "d".a3 = 'central Bohemia' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "disp" AS "any_disp" INNER JOIN "card" AS "ca" ON "ca".disp_id = "any_disp".disp_id WHERE "any_disp".account_id = "owner_disp".account_id) GROUP BY "d".district_id) AS "district_values" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE("l".loan_count, 0)::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_loans_per_account" FROM (SELECT "d".account_id FROM "disp" AS "d" INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "d".client_id WHERE "d".type = 'OWNER' AND "c".birth_date < DATE '1950-01-01') AS "owner_accounts" LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "loan_count" FROM "loan" GROUP BY account_id) AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "owner_accounts".account_id LIMIT 501

WITH "borrowing" AS (SELECT "l".account_id, SUM("l".amount) AS "total_borrowed" FROM "loan" AS "l" GROUP BY "l".account_id), "counterparties" AS (SELECT "t".account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "t".account) AS "counterparty_count" FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".operation IN ('PREVOD NA UCET', 'PREVOD Z UCTU') AND "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".account IS NOT NULL AND "t".account <> 0 GROUP BY "t".account_id), "households" AS (SELECT "a".account_id, "a".date, "b".total_borrowed, COALESCE("cp".counterparty_count, 0) AS "counterparty_count", "hd".a2 AS "home_district", "hd".a4::BIGINT AS "population" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "borrowing" AS "b" ON "b".account_id = "a".account_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "owner_disp" ON "owner_disp".account_id = "a".account_id AND "owner_disp".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "owner_disp".client_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "hd" ON "hd".district_id = "c".district_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "branch" ON "branch".district_id = "a".district_id LEFT JOIN "counterparties" AS "cp" ON "cp".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "branch".a2 = 'Prachatice') SELECT account_id, date, total_borrowed, counterparty_count, home_district, population, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY population DESC) AS "population_rank" FROM "households" ORDER BY population DESC, account_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible_accounts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "a".account_id, "a".district_id, "c".gender FROM "card" AS "ca" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "owner_disp" ON "owner_disp".disp_id = "ca".disp_id AND "owner_disp".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "owner_disp".client_id INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "owner_disp".account_id INNER JOIN (SELECT account_id FROM "trans" GROUP BY account_id HAVING AVG(balance) > 1000) AS "avg_bal" ON "avg_bal".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "ca".type = 'gold'), "eligible_districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "ea".gender, "d".district_id, "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a4::BIGINT AS "inhabitants", "d".a11::NUMERIC AS "salary", "d".a13::NUMERIC AS "urban_ratio" FROM "eligible_accounts" AS "ea" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "ea".district_id WHERE "d".a4::BIGINT > 100000), "stats" AS (SELECT gender, COUNT(*) AS "district_count", AVG(salary) AS "avg_salary", AVG(urban_ratio) AS "avg_urban_ratio", MAX(inhabitants) AS "max_inhabitants" FROM "eligible_districts" GROUP BY gender) SELECT CASE "s".gender WHEN 'F' THEN 'women' ELSE 'men' END AS "gender", "s".district_count, "ed".district_name, "ed".inhabitants, ROUND("s".avg_salary, 2) AS "average_salary", ROUND("s".avg_urban_ratio, 2) AS "average_urban_inhabitant_ratio" FROM "stats" AS "s" INNER JOIN "eligible_districts" AS "ed" ON "ed".gender = "s".gender AND "ed".inhabitants = "s".max_inhabitants ORDER BY CASE "s".gender WHEN 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC, "ed".district_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible_accounts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "a".account_id FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "owner_disp" ON "owner_disp".account_id = "a".account_id AND "owner_disp".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "card" AS "c" ON "c".disp_id = "owner_disp".disp_id AND "c".type = 'gold' WHERE CAST("d".a4 AS BIGINT) >= 250000), "totals" AS (SELECT "t".bank, "t".account AS "counter_account", COUNT(*) AS "outgoing_payments", SUM("t".amount) AS "total_amount" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "eligible_accounts" AS "ea" ON "ea".account_id = "t".account_id WHERE "t".date >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND "t".date < DATE '1999-01-01' AND "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".account IS NOT NULL AND "t".account <> 0 GROUP BY "t".bank, "t".account) SELECT bank, counter_account, outgoing_payments, total_amount FROM "totals" WHERE total_amount = (SELECT MAX(total_amount) FROM "totals") ORDER BY bank ASC, counter_account ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN "t".k_symbol = 'SIPO' THEN "t".amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM("t".amount), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "t".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "d".a2 = 'Pisek' AND "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "t".k_symbol IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("t".k_symbol) <> '' LIMIT 501

WITH "qualifying_accounts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "dp".account_id FROM "disp" AS "dp" INNER JOIN "card" AS "ca" ON "ca".disp_id = "dp".disp_id INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "dp".account_id), "eligible_districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "c".district_id FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".client_id = "c".client_id INNER JOIN "qualifying_accounts" AS "qa" ON "qa".account_id = "dp".account_id WHERE "c".gender = 'F' AND "dp".type = 'OWNER'), "region_stats" AS (SELECT "d".a3 AS "region", ROUND(AVG("d".a12)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_district_salary", ROUND(AVG("d".a13)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_1996_district_unemployment_rate" FROM "eligible_districts" AS "ed" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "ed".district_id GROUP BY "d".a3), "district_populations" AS (SELECT "d".a3 AS "region", "d".a2 AS "district", "d".a4::BIGINT AS "population" FROM "eligible_districts" AS "ed" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "ed".district_id), "ranked_populations" AS (SELECT region, district, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY population DESC, district ASC) AS "rn" FROM "district_populations") SELECT "rs".region, "rs".average_district_salary, "rs".average_1996_district_unemployment_rate, "rp".district AS "most_populous_district" FROM "region_stats" AS "rs" INNER JOIN "ranked_populations" AS "rp" ON "rp".region = "rs".region AND "rp".rn = 1 ORDER BY "rs".region ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "card_districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "ca"."type" AS "card_type", "cl".district_id FROM "card" AS "ca" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".disp_id = "ca".disp_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "cl" ON "cl".client_id = "dp".client_id), "ranked" AS (SELECT "cd".card_type, "d".a2 AS "home_district", "d".a4::BIGINT AS "inhabitants", RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "cd".card_type ORDER BY "d".a4::BIGINT ASC) AS "rnk" FROM "card_districts" AS "cd" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "cd".district_id) SELECT card_type, home_district, inhabitants FROM "ranked" WHERE rnk = 1 ORDER BY CASE card_type WHEN 'gold' THEN 1 WHEN 'classic' THEN 2 WHEN 'junior' THEN 3 END ASC, home_district ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "opened_accounts" AS (SELECT "a".account_id, "a".district_id FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'north Bohemia' AND "a".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND "a".date < DATE '1997-01-01'), "latest_balance" AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON ("t".account_id) "t".account_id, "t".balance FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "opened_accounts" AS "oa" ON "oa".account_id = "t".account_id WHERE "t".date < DATE '1997-01-01' ORDER BY "t".account_id ASC, "t".date DESC, "t".trans_id DESC), "account_balances" AS (SELECT "oa".district_id, "lb".balance FROM "opened_accounts" AS "oa" INNER JOIN "latest_balance" AS "lb" ON "lb".account_id = "oa".account_id), "district_stats" AS (SELECT "d".a2 AS "district_name", COUNT(*) AS "accounts_opened", ROUND(AVG("ab".balance::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_balance" FROM "account_balances" AS "ab" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "ab".district_id GROUP BY "d".district_id, "d".a2) SELECT district_name, accounts_opened, average_balance, ROUND((SELECT AVG(balance::NUMERIC) FROM "account_balances"), 2) AS "region_wide_average", (SELECT district_name FROM "district_stats" ORDER BY average_balance DESC, district_name ASC LIMIT 1) AS "highest_average_district" FROM "district_stats" ORDER BY district_name ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "ranked_loans" AS (SELECT "l".loan_id, "l".amount, "a".district_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "l".amount DESC, "l".loan_id ASC) AS "loan_rank" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id WHERE "l".duration = 24 AND "a".frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'), "selected_districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT district_id FROM "ranked_loans" WHERE loan_rank <= 10), "district_stats" AS (SELECT "d".district_id, "d".a4::BIGINT AS "inhabitants", "d".a11 AS "average_salary" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "selected_districts" AS "sd" ON "sd".district_id = "d".district_id), "summary" AS (SELECT (SELECT district_id FROM "district_stats" ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, district_id ASC LIMIT 1) AS "most_populous_district_id", (SELECT inhabitants FROM "district_stats" ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, district_id ASC LIMIT 1) AS "inhabitants", ROUND(AVG(average_salary)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_salary_across_districts" FROM "district_stats") SELECT most_populous_district_id, inhabitants, average_salary_across_districts FROM "summary" LIMIT 501

WITH "account_counts" AS (SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS "account_count" FROM "account" GROUP BY district_id), "withdrawals" AS (SELECT "a".district_id, SUM("t".amount) AS "total_withdrawn" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "t".type = 'VYDAJ' GROUP BY "a".district_id), "standing_orders" AS (SELECT "a".district_id, SUM("o".amount) AS "total_standing_order_debit" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "order" AS "o" ON "o".account_id = "a".account_id GROUP BY "a".district_id), "district_metrics" AS (SELECT "d".district_id, "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a3 AS "region", "d".a4::BIGINT AS "population", "w".total_withdrawn, "w".total_withdrawn::NUMERIC / "d".a4::NUMERIC AS "withdrawals_per_inhabitant", COALESCE("s".total_standing_order_debit, 0)::NUMERIC / "ac".account_count AS "average_standing_order_debit_per_account" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "account_counts" AS "ac" ON "ac".district_id = "d".district_id INNER JOIN "withdrawals" AS "w" ON "w".district_id = "d".district_id LEFT JOIN "standing_orders" AS "s" ON "s".district_id = "d".district_id WHERE "d".a4::BIGINT >= 100000) SELECT district_name, region, population, total_withdrawn, ROUND(withdrawals_per_inhabitant, 2) AS "withdrawals_per_inhabitant", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY withdrawals_per_inhabitant DESC) AS "rank_by_withdrawals_per_inhabitant", ROUND(average_standing_order_debit_per_account, 2) AS "average_standing_order_debit_per_account" FROM "district_metrics" ORDER BY rank_by_withdrawals_per_inhabitant ASC, district_name ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "accessible" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "a".account_id, "a".date AS "opened_date", "a".frequency, "a".district_id AS "account_district_id", "c".district_id AS "client_district_id" FROM "disp" AS "dp" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "dp".account_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "dp".client_id WHERE "dp".client_id = 3541), "tx" AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "transaction_count", SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "total_income", SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "total_expense" FROM "trans" GROUP BY account_id), "regional_districts" AS (SELECT "d".district_id, "d".a3 AS "region", "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a4::BIGINT AS "inhabitants", "d".a11 AS "average_salary", RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "d".a3 ORDER BY "d".a4::BIGINT DESC) AS "population_rank", FIRST_VALUE("d".a2) OVER (PARTITION BY "d".a3 ORDER BY "d".a4::BIGINT DESC) AS "most_populous_name", FIRST_VALUE("d".a4::BIGINT) OVER (PARTITION BY "d".a3 ORDER BY "d".a4::BIGINT DESC) AS "most_populous_inhabitants" FROM "district" AS "d"), "client_region_counts" AS (SELECT "d".a3 AS "region", COUNT(*) AS "clients_in_region" FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "c".district_id GROUP BY "d".a3) SELECT "x".account_id, "x".opened_date, "x".frequency, "rd".district_name, "rd".region, CASE WHEN "x".account_district_id = "x".client_district_id THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS "is_home_district", "rd".average_salary, COALESCE("l".status, 'none') AS "loan_repayment_status", COALESCE("l".amount, 0) AS "loan_amount", COALESCE("tx".transaction_count, 0) AS "transaction_count", COALESCE("tx".total_income, 0) AS "total_income", COALESCE("tx".total_expense, 0) AS "total_expense", COALESCE("tx".total_income, 0) - COALESCE("tx".total_expense, 0) AS "net_balance", "crc".clients_in_region, "rd".most_populous_name, "rd".most_populous_inhabitants, "rd".population_rank FROM "accessible" AS "x" INNER JOIN "regional_districts" AS "rd" ON "rd".district_id = "x".account_district_id LEFT JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "x".account_id LEFT JOIN "tx" ON "tx".account_id = "x".account_id INNER JOIN "client_region_counts" AS "crc" ON "crc".region = "rd".region ORDER BY COALESCE("tx".transaction_count, 0) DESC, "x".account_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "account_lending" AS (SELECT "a".account_id, "a".district_id, "a".date, COALESCE(SUM("l".amount), 0) AS "amount_lent" FROM "account" AS "a" LEFT JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "a".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY "a".account_id, "a".district_id, "a".date), "district_year" AS (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "al".date)::INTEGER AS "year_num", "al".district_id, COUNT(*) AS "accounts_opened", SUM("al".amount_lent) AS "amount_lent" FROM "account_lending" AS "al" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "al".district_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'central Bohemia' GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "al".date)::INTEGER, "al".district_id), "year_totals" AS (SELECT year_num, SUM(accounts_opened) AS "accounts_opened", SUM(amount_lent) AS "amount_lent", AVG(amount_lent::NUMERIC / accounts_opened) AS "avg_district_amount_lent_per_account" FROM "district_year" GROUP BY year_num) SELECT year_num::TEXT AS "year", accounts_opened, amount_lent, ROUND(avg_district_amount_lent_per_account, 2) AS "average_district_amount_lent_per_account" FROM "year_totals" ORDER BY year_num ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "ranked_loans" AS (SELECT "l".loan_id, "l".account_id, "l".amount, "l".date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "l".amount DESC, "l".date ASC, "l".loan_id ASC) AS "loan_rank" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id WHERE "l".duration = 24 AND "a".frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'), "top_loans" AS (SELECT * FROM "ranked_loans" WHERE loan_rank <= 10), "final_balances" AS (SELECT "t".account_id, "t".date, "t".balance, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "t".account_id, "t".date ORDER BY "t".trans_id DESC) AS "transaction_rank" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "top_loans" AS "tl" ON "tl".account_id = "t".account_id AND "tl".date = "t".date) SELECT "d".a2 AS "district", "tl".amount AS "approved_amount", "tl".date AS "approval_date", "fb".balance AS "account_balance" FROM "top_loans" AS "tl" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "tl".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id LEFT JOIN "final_balances" AS "fb" ON "fb".account_id = "tl".account_id AND "fb".date = "tl".date AND "fb".transaction_rank = 1 ORDER BY "tl".amount DESC, "tl".date ASC, "tl".loan_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "loan_summary" AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "loan_count", SUM(amount) AS "total_amount_borrowed" FROM "loan" GROUP BY account_id), "card_clients" AS (SELECT "c".client_id, "c".gender, "c".birth_date, "ca".type AS "card_type", EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "ca".issued)::INTEGER - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "c".birth_date)::INTEGER AS "age_at_issue", COALESCE("ls".loan_count, 0) AS "loan_count", COALESCE("ls".total_amount_borrowed, 0) AS "total_amount_borrowed", CASE WHEN "ls".loan_count IS NOT NULL AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "ca".issued) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "c".birth_date) < 30 THEN 'Young borrower' WHEN "ls".loan_count IS NOT NULL AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "ca".issued) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "c".birth_date) >= 30 THEN 'Mature borrower' ELSE 'Non-borrower' END AS "borrower_classification", "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a11 AS "district_average_salary", RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "c".gender ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "ca".issued) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "c".birth_date) ASC) AS "age_rank_within_gender" FROM "card" AS "ca" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".disp_id = "ca".disp_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "dp".client_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "c".district_id LEFT JOIN "loan_summary" AS "ls" ON "ls".account_id = "dp".account_id WHERE "ca".issued >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND "ca".issued < DATE '1995-01-01') SELECT client_id, gender, birth_date, card_type, age_at_issue, loan_count, total_amount_borrowed, borrower_classification, district_name, district_average_salary, age_rank_within_gender FROM "card_clients" ORDER BY client_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a2 AS "branch_name", COUNT("t".trans_id) AS "transaction_count" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'north Moravia' AND "t".date <= DATE '1998-10-14' AND "t".k_symbol IS NULL GROUP BY "d".district_id, "d".a2 ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, branch_name ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT bank, account, COUNT(*) AS "outgoing_payment_count", SUM(amount) AS "total_amount_paid" FROM "trans" WHERE account_id = 11265 AND type = 'VYDAJ' AND date < DATE '1996-01-03' AND bank IS NOT NULL AND account IS NOT NULL AND account <> 0 GROUP BY bank, account ORDER BY total_amount_paid DESC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".account_id) FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id WHERE "a".district_id = 1 AND "a".date <= DATE '1995-12-31' AND "l".status IN ('C', 'D') AND "l".date <= DATE '1995-12-31' LIMIT 501

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN "t".k_symbol = 'UROK' THEN "t".amount WHEN "t".k_symbol = 'SANKC. WITH "french_editions" AS (SELECT "r".raceid, "r".date FROM "races" AS "r" WHERE "r".name = 'French Grand Prix' AND "r".year >= 1990), "driver_laps" AS (SELECT "fe".raceid, "fe".date, "d".forename, "d".surname, MIN("lt".milliseconds) AS "fastest_ms" FROM "french_editions" AS "fe" INNER JOIN "laptimes" AS "lt" ON "lt".raceid = "fe".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "lt".driverid GROUP BY "fe".raceid, "fe".date, "d".driverid, "d".forename, "d".surname), "slow_laps" AS (SELECT raceid, date, forename, surname, fastest_ms FROM "driver_laps" WHERE fastest_ms > 90000), "combined" AS (SELECT date, forename, surname, (fastest_ms / 60000)::TEXT || ':' || CASE WHEN (fastest_ms % 60000) / 1000 < 10 THEN '0' ELSE '' END || ((fastest_ms % 60000) / 1000)::TEXT || '.' || CASE WHEN fastest_ms % 1000 < 10 THEN '00' WHEN fastest_ms % 1000 < 100 THEN '0' ELSE '' END || (fastest_ms % 1000)::TEXT AS "fastest_lap_time", raceid FROM "slow_laps" UNION ALL SELECT "fe".date, NULL::TEXT, NULL::TEXT, NULL::TEXT, "fe".raceid FROM "french_editions" AS "fe" WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "slow_laps" AS "s" WHERE "s".raceid = "fe".raceid)) SELECT date, forename, surname, fastest_lap_time FROM "combined" ORDER BY date ASC, surname ASC NULLS LAST, forename ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 501

SELECT "d"."forename", "d"."surname", "q"."q3" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d"."driverid" = "q"."driverid" WHERE "d"."nationality" = 'Italian' AND "q"."q3" IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("q"."q3") <> '' AND CAST(SPLIT_PART("q"."q3", ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 60000 + CAST(SPLIT_PART("q"."q3", ':', 2) AS NUMERIC) = (SELECT MIN(CAST(SPLIT_PART("q2"."q3", ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 60000 + CAST(SPLIT_PART("q2"."q3", ':', 2) AS NUMERIC)) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d2" ON "d2"."driverid" = "q2"."driverid" WHERE "d2"."nationality" = 'Italian' AND "q2"."q3" IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("q2"."q3") <> '') LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename || ' ' || "d".surname AS "Driver full name", "r".name AS "Race name", "r".year AS "Race year", "q".q3 AS "Q3 time" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "d".nationality = 'British' AND "d".dob >= DATE '1981-01-01' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q3) <> '' AND "q".q3 = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d2" ON "q2".driverid = "d2".driverid WHERE "d2".nationality = 'British' AND "d2".dob >= DATE '1981-01-01' AND "q2".q3 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q2".q3) <> '') LIMIT 501

WITH "driver_race_best" AS (SELECT raceid, driverid, MIN(milliseconds) AS "best_milliseconds" FROM "laptimes" WHERE milliseconds IS NOT NULL GROUP BY raceid, driverid), "ranked" AS (SELECT raceid, driverid, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY raceid ORDER BY best_milliseconds ASC) AS "lap_rank" FROM "driver_race_best") SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "r".driverid) AS "driver_count" FROM "ranked" AS "r" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "r".driverid WHERE "r".lap_rank = 2 AND "d".dob >= DATE '1976-01-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".driverref FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q3 <> '' AND "q".q3 = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".raceid = "q".raceid AND "q2".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q2".q3 <> '') LIMIT 501

WITH "constructor_season_points" AS (SELECT "c".constructorid, "c".name, "c".url, "r".year, MAX("cs".points) AS "season_points" FROM "constructors" AS "c" LEFT JOIN "constructorstandings" AS "cs" ON "cs".constructorid = "c".constructorid LEFT JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "cs".raceid WHERE "c".nationality = 'Italian' GROUP BY "c".constructorid, "c".name, "c".url, "r".year), "career_totals" AS (SELECT constructorid, name, url, COALESCE(SUM(season_points), 0) AS "career_points" FROM "constructor_season_points" GROUP BY constructorid, name, url), "ranked" AS (SELECT name, career_points, url, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY career_points DESC) AS "rank" FROM "career_totals") SELECT name, career_points, url FROM "ranked" WHERE rank <= 3 ORDER BY rank ASC, name ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT "d".forename, COUNT(DISTINCT "d".driverid) AS "driver_count" FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "d".forename IN ('Peter', 'John') AND "res".position = 1 GROUP BY "d".forename ORDER BY "d".forename ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "d".nationality FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q3) <> '' AND "q".q3 = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".q3 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q2".q3) <> '') LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".nationality, COUNT(DISTINCT "c".constructorid) AS "constructor_count" FROM "constructors" AS "c" LEFT JOIN (SELECT "r".constructorid FROM "results" AS "r" WHERE "r".rank = 1) AS "fl" ON "fl".constructorid = "c".constructorid GROUP BY "c".nationality ORDER BY "c".nationality ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".year, COUNT(*) AS "total_pit_stops" FROM "pitstops" AS "p" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "p".raceid INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "ds".raceid FROM "driverstandings" AS "ds" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "ds".driverid WHERE "d".nationality = 'Australian' AND "ds".position BETWEEN 1 AND 19) AS "qualifying_races" ON "qualifying_races".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "r".year BETWEEN 2002 AND 2013 GROUP BY "r".year ORDER BY "r".year ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "q".driverid) AS "driver_count" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid WHERE "r".year = 1995 AND "q".q1 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q1) <> '' AND "q".q1 > '2:00.000' LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename || ' ' || "d".surname AS "driver_name", "p".duration AS "pit_stop_time", "r".name AS "race_name", "c".name AS "circuit_name", "c".location AS "circuit_location" FROM "pitstops" AS "p" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "p".driverid = "d".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "p".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "r".circuitid = "c".circuitid WHERE "r".date >= DATE '2016-09-01' AND "r".date < DATE '2016-10-01' AND "p".milliseconds IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "p".milliseconds ASC LIMIT 1

WITH "winners" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "d".driverid, "d".forename, "d".surname, "d".nationality, "d".dob FROM "results" AS "r" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "r".driverid WHERE "r".position = 1), "selected_driver" AS (SELECT driverid, forename, surname, nationality, dob FROM "winners" ORDER BY dob ASC, forename ASC, surname ASC LIMIT 1), "first_win" AS (SELECT "ra".name, "ra".date FROM "results" AS "r" INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "ra".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "selected_driver" AS "sd" ON "sd".driverid = "r".driverid WHERE "r".position = 1 ORDER BY "ra".date ASC, "ra".name ASC LIMIT 1) SELECT "sd".forename || ' ' || "sd".surname AS "full_name", "sd".nationality, "fw".name AS "first_race_won", "fw".date AS "first_race_date", COUNT("r".raceid) AS "races_started" FROM "selected_driver" AS "sd" CROSS JOIN "first_win" AS "fw" INNER JOIN "results" AS "r" ON "r".driverid = "sd".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "ra".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "ra".year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2017 GROUP BY "sd".forename, "sd".surname, "sd".nationality, "fw".name, "fw".date LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "r".raceid) FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "status" AS "s" ON "s".statusid = "res".statusid WHERE "r".name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND "s".status = 'Accident' LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname, "c".name FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid INNER JOIN "constructors" AS "c" ON "c".constructorid = "q".constructorid INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "q".raceid AND "res".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q2 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q2 <> '' ORDER BY "q".q2 ASC, "res".grid ASC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1

WITH "q2_times" AS (SELECT "q".driverid, "r".name AS "race_name", "q".q2, MIN("q".q2) OVER () AS "fastest_q2" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "q".q2 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q2) <> '') SELECT "d".surname, race_name FROM "q2_times" AS "qt" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "qt".driverid WHERE "qt".q2 = "qt".fastest_q2 ORDER BY "d".surname ASC, race_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".number FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "qualifying" AS "q" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q3 <> '' AND "q".q3 = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".raceid = "r".raceid AND "q2".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q2".q3 <> '') LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".code, "q".q3 FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q3) <> '' ORDER BY SPLIT_PART("q".q3, ':', 1)::INTEGER * 60000 + SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART("q".q3, ':', 2), '.', 1)::INTEGER * 1000 + SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART("q".q3, ':', 2), '.', 2)::INTEGER ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT "d".nationality FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "q".raceid = "ra".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "ra".year = 2017 AND "ra".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q3 <> '' AND "q".q3 = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".raceid = "q".raceid AND "q2".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q2".q3 <> '') LIMIT 501

WITH "chinese_races" AS (SELECT raceid, year, time FROM "races" WHERE name = 'Chinese Grand Prix' AND year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2009 AND time IS NOT NULL), "earliest" AS (SELECT raceid, year FROM "chinese_races" ORDER BY time ASC, year DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT "e".year, "ru".time AS "runner_up_time_gap" FROM "earliest" AS "e" INNER JOIN "results" AS "ru" ON "ru".raceid = "e".raceid AND "ru".position = 2 LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "d".code FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q3) <> '' AND "d".code IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("d".code) <> '' ORDER BY "d".code ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".year, "d".forename, "d".surname, "res".time FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "res".driverid WHERE "r".name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND "r".year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2017 AND "r".time IS NOT NULL AND "r".time <= '17:00:00' AND "res".position = 1 ORDER BY "r".year ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".number, "d".surname FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("q".q3) <> '' AND "q".q3::INTERVAL < INTERVAL '1 minute 38 seconds' LIMIT 501

WITH "timed_races" AS (SELECT "r".raceid, "r".time, "c".circuitref FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid WHERE "r".time IS NOT NULL), "seconds" AS (SELECT raceid, circuitref, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM time::TIME) * 3600 + EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM time::TIME) * 60 + EXTRACT(SECOND FROM time::TIME) AS "start_seconds" FROM "timed_races"), "extremes" AS (SELECT MIN(start_seconds) AS "earliest_seconds", MAX(start_seconds) AS "latest_seconds" FROM "seconds") SELECT (SELECT STRING_AGG(DISTINCT circuitref, ', ' ORDER BY circuitref ASC) FROM "seconds", "extremes" WHERE start_seconds = earliest_seconds) AS "earliest_circuit_refs", (SELECT STRING_AGG(DISTINCT circuitref, ', ' ORDER BY circuitref ASC) FROM "seconds", "extremes" WHERE start_seconds = latest_seconds) AS "latest_circuit_refs", latest_seconds - earliest_seconds AS "gap_seconds" FROM "extremes" LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "results" AS "r" ON "r".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "d".dob >= DATE '1980-01-01' AND "d".dob < DATE '1991-01-01' AND "r".fastestlapspeed IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("r".fastestlapspeed) <> '' ORDER BY "r".fastestlapspeed::NUMERIC DESC, "d".dob ASC, "d".surname ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT "d".driverref FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "ra".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "ra".year = 2017 AND "ra".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q1 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q1 <> '' AND "q".q2 IS NULL ORDER BY "q".q1 DESC, "d".driverid ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "r".driverid) FROM "results" AS "r" INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "r".raceid = "ra".raceid INNER JOIN "status" AS "s" ON "r".statusid = "s".statusid WHERE "ra".year = 1962 AND "ra".name = 'British Grand Prix' AND "s".status = 'Withdrew' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "s".status = 'Finished' OR "s".status LIKE '+% Laps') / COUNT(*), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "results" AS "r" INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "ra".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "status" AS "s" ON "s".statusid = "r".statusid WHERE "ra".year = 1957 AND "ra".name = 'British Grand Prix' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(event_expense_total)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "mean_total_expense_per_event" FROM (SELECT "b".link_to_event, SUM("ex".cost) AS "event_expense_total" FROM "expense" AS "ex" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "ex".link_to_member = "m".member_id INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "ex".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "m".first_name = 'Elijah' AND "m".last_name = 'Allen' AND "ex".expense_date >= '2019-09-01' AND "ex".expense_date < '2019-11-01' GROUP BY "b".link_to_event) AS "event_totals" LIMIT 501

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE("e".event_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) = 2019 THEN "b".spent ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE("e".event_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) = 2020 THEN "b".spent ELSE 0 END) AS "total_spent_2019_minus_2020" FROM "budget" AS "b" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id LIMIT 501
SELECT notes FROM "income" WHERE source = 'Fundraising' AND date_received = '2019-09-14' LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".status = 'Closed' GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name HAVING SUM("b".spent) / NULLIF(SUM("b".amount), 0) = (SELECT MAX(event_ratio) FROM (SELECT SUM("b2".spent) / NULLIF(SUM("b2".amount), 0) AS "event_ratio" FROM "event" AS "e2" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b2" ON "b2".link_to_event = "e2".event_id WHERE "e2".status = 'Closed' GROUP BY "e2".event_id) AS "ratios") LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".first_name, "m".last_name FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_member = "m".member_id GROUP BY "m".member_id, "m".first_name, "m".last_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_event) > 7 LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "m".first_name, "m".last_name, "m".phone FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "e" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id WHERE "e".cost > (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM "expense") LIMIT 501

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "attendance" AS "a" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_name = 'Women''s Soccer') AS "womens_soccer_attendance", (SELECT ROUND(AVG(event_attendance::NUMERIC), 1) FROM (SELECT "e".event_id, COUNT("a".link_to_member) AS "event_attendance" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-09-01' AND "e".event_date < '2019-12-01' GROUP BY "e".event_id) AS "fall_events") AS "fall_2019_average_attendance", CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "attendance" AS "a" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_name = 'Women''s Soccer') > (SELECT ROUND(AVG(event_attendance::NUMERIC), 1) FROM (SELECT "e".event_id, COUNT("a".link_to_member) AS "event_attendance" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-09-01' AND "e".event_date < '2019-12-01' GROUP BY "e".event_id) AS "fall_events") THEN 'more' WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "attendance" AS "a" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_name = 'Women''s Soccer') < (SELECT ROUND(AVG(event_attendance::NUMERIC), 1) FROM (SELECT "e".event_id, COUNT("a".link_to_member) AS "event_attendance" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-09-01' AND "e".event_date < '2019-12-01' GROUP BY "e".event_id) AS "fall_events") THEN 'fewer' ELSE 'equal' END AS "verdict" LIMIT 501

WITH "college_majors" AS (SELECT major_id, major_name, department FROM "major" WHERE college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences'), "member_counts" AS (SELECT "cm".department, "cm".major_id, "cm".major_name, COUNT("m".member_id) AS "members_in_major" FROM "college_majors" AS "cm" LEFT JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "m".link_to_major = "cm".major_id GROUP BY "cm".department, "cm".major_id, "cm".major_name) SELECT department AS "department_name", STRING_AGG(major_name, ', ' ORDER BY major_name ASC) AS "majors_offered", COALESCE(STRING_AGG(major_name, ', ' ORDER BY major_name ASC) FILTER (WHERE members_in_major > 0), '') AS "majors_held_by_members", ROUND(AVG(members_in_major)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_members_per_major" FROM "member_counts" GROUP BY department ORDER BY department ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "q".event_type, SUM("q".members_attended) AS "members_attended", SUM("q".event_budget) AS "total_budgeted_amount" FROM (SELECT "e"."type" AS "event_type", COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "members_attended", COALESCE((SELECT SUM("b".amount) FROM "budget" AS "b" WHERE "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id), 0) AS "event_budget" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-01-01' AND "e".event_date < '2020-01-01' GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e"."type") AS "q" GROUP BY "q".event_type ORDER BY "q".event_type ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "dept".department, COALESCE(SUM("i".amount), 0) AS "total_dues" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT department, college FROM "major") AS "dept" LEFT JOIN "major" AS "mj" ON "mj".department = "dept".department AND "mj".college = "dept".college LEFT JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "m".link_to_major = "mj".major_id AND "m".position = 'Member' LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT link_to_member FROM "attendance") AS "a" ON "a".link_to_member = "m".member_id LEFT JOIN "income" AS "i" ON "i".link_to_member = "m".member_id AND "i".source = 'Dues' WHERE "dept".college = 'College of Engineering' AND ("a".link_to_member IS NOT NULL OR "m".member_id IS NULL) GROUP BY "dept".department ORDER BY "dept".department ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".first_name, "m".last_name, ROUND(SUM("b".amount - "b".spent)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "total_amount_left" FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "e" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".budget_id = "e".link_to_budget WHERE "e".cost > 50 GROUP BY "m".member_id, "m".first_name, "m".last_name ORDER BY total_amount_left DESC, "m".last_name ASC, "m".first_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COALESCE(SUM("i".amount), 0) AS "total_dues_dollars" FROM "income" AS "i" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "i".link_to_member = "a".link_to_member INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "i".source = 'Dues' AND "e".event_name ILIKE '%Football game%' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "m2".major_name) AS "major_count" FROM "major" AS "target_major" INNER JOIN "member" AS "tyler" ON "tyler".link_to_major = "target_major".major_id INNER JOIN "major" AS "m2" ON "m2".college = "target_major".college WHERE "tyler".first_name = 'Tyler' AND "tyler".last_name = 'Hewitt' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "member" AS "enrolled" INNER JOIN "major" AS "enrolled_major" ON "enrolled".link_to_major = "enrolled_major".major_id WHERE "enrolled_major".major_name = "m2".major_name AND "enrolled_major".college = "m2".college) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(attendee_count), 2) AS "average_attendees_per_event" FROM (SELECT "e".event_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "attendee_count" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "b".category = 'Advertisement' GROUP BY "e".event_id) AS "event_attendance" LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name, "e".location, COUNT("a".link_to_member) AS "attendees" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".type = 'Budget' GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name, "e".location LIMIT 501

SELECT "m_major".major_name, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "attendee_count" FROM "attendance" AS "a" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "e".event_id = "a".link_to_event INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "m".member_id = "a".link_to_member INNER JOIN "major" AS "m_major" ON "m_major".major_id = "m".link_to_major WHERE "e".event_name = 'Football game' GROUP BY "m_major".major_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) = (SELECT MAX(major_attendee_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "a2".link_to_member) AS "major_attendee_count" FROM "attendance" AS "a2" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e2" ON "e2".event_id = "a2".link_to_event INNER JOIN "member" AS "m2" ON "m2".member_id = "a2".link_to_member INNER JOIN "major" AS "m_major2" ON "m_major2".major_id = "m2".link_to_major WHERE "e2".event_name = 'Football game' GROUP BY "m_major2".major_name) AS "counts_by_major") ORDER BY "m_major".major_name ASC LIMIT 501
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "member" AS "m" WHERE "m".link_to_major = "major".major_id)) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "major" LIMIT 501

WITH "member_attendance" AS (SELECT "m".member_id, "m".position, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_event) AS "events_attended" FROM "member" AS "m" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_member = "m".member_id GROUP BY "m".member_id, "m".position), "group_averages" AS (SELECT CASE WHEN position IN ('President', 'Vice President', 'Secretary', 'Treasurer') THEN 'officer' ELSE 'other student' END AS "member_group", ROUND(AVG(events_attended)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_events_attended" FROM "member_attendance" GROUP BY CASE WHEN position IN ('President', 'Vice President', 'Secretary', 'Treasurer') THEN 'officer' ELSE 'other student' END) SELECT MAX(average_events_attended) FILTER (WHERE member_group = 'officer') AS "average_events_per_officer", MAX(average_events_attended) FILTER (WHERE member_group = 'other student') AS "average_events_per_other_student" FROM "group_averages" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN expense_description ILIKE '%Water%' THEN 'Water' END) + COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN expense_description ILIKE '%Cookies%' OR expense_description ILIKE '%cookies%' THEN 'Cookies' END) + COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN expense_description ILIKE '%chips%' THEN 'chips' END) + COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN expense_description ILIKE '%Pizza%' THEN 'Pizza' END) AS "count" FROM "expense" AS "x" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".budget_id = "x".link_to_budget WHERE "b".remaining < 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name, TO_CHAR(ROUND(COALESCE("w".water_spend, 0)::NUMERIC / "a".attendee_count, 2), 'FM999999990.00') AS "amount_spent_per_attendee" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN (SELECT link_to_event, COUNT(*) AS "attendee_count" FROM "attendance" GROUP BY link_to_event) AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT "b".link_to_event, SUM("x".cost) AS "water_spend" FROM "budget" AS "b" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "x".expense_description ILIKE '%water%' GROUP BY "b".link_to_event) AS "w" ON "w".link_to_event = "e".event_id ORDER BY "e".event_name ASC, "e".event_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "major".college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences' THEN 'major in College of Humanities and Social Sciences' ELSE 'not majoring in College of Humanities and Social Sciences' END AS "group_name", COUNT(*) AS "member_count" FROM "member" LEFT JOIN "major" ON "member".link_to_major = "major".major_id GROUP BY CASE WHEN "major".college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences' THEN 'major in College of Humanities and Social Sciences' ELSE 'not majoring in College of Humanities and Social Sciences' END LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "ev".event_name FROM "event" AS "ev" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "ev".event_id INNER JOIN "expense" AS "ex" ON "ex".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "ex".expense_description ILIKE '%chips%' AND "b".amount = (SELECT MAX("b2".amount) FROM "budget" AS "b2" WHERE "b2".link_to_event = "ev".event_id) AND "b".amount = (SELECT MAX("b3".amount) FROM "budget" AS "b3" WHERE "b3".link_to_event IN (SELECT "b4".link_to_event FROM "budget" AS "b4" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "ex2" ON "ex2".link_to_budget = "b4".budget_id WHERE "ex2".expense_description ILIKE '%chips%')) LIMIT 501

WITH "latest" AS (SELECT MAX("e".expense_date) AS "expense_date" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id WHERE "m".position = 'Vice President') SELECT "l".expense_date, SUM("e".cost) AS "total_cost" FROM "latest" AS "l" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "e" ON "e".expense_date = "l".expense_date GROUP BY "l".expense_date ORDER BY "l".expense_date DESC LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".type, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "member_count" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".location = 'MU 215' GROUP BY "e".type ORDER BY "e".type ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "college_counts" AS (SELECT "major".college, COUNT(DISTINCT "major".major_id) AS "number_of_majors" FROM "member" INNER JOIN "major" ON "member".link_to_major = "major".major_id WHERE "major".college IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "major".college), "ranked" AS (SELECT college, number_of_majors, MAX(number_of_majors) OVER () AS "max_count" FROM "college_counts") SELECT college, number_of_majors FROM "ranked" WHERE number_of_majors = max_count ORDER BY college ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".location, COUNT(DISTINCT "ex".expense_description) AS "number_of_different_things_bought" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id INNER JOIN "expense" AS "ex" ON "ex".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "b".amount > 40 AND "e".location IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "e".location LIMIT 501

SELECT SUM("b".amount) AS "total_budgeted" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "bx".link_to_event FROM "budget" AS "bx" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "bx".budget_id WHERE "x".expense_description = 'Pizza') AS "pe" ON "pe".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-09-01' AND "e".event_date < '2019-10-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(event_spent)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_spent_per_event" FROM (SELECT "e".event_id, COALESCE(SUM(NULLIF("b".spent, 0)), 0) AS "event_spent" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id GROUP BY "e".event_id) AS "event_totals" LIMIT 501

WITH "event_totals" AS (SELECT "e".event_id, "e".event_name, COALESCE(SUM("b".amount), 0) AS "total_budget", COALESCE(SUM("b".spent), 0) AS "total_spending", COUNT("x".expense_id) AS "purchases" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id LEFT JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "e".status = 'Closed' GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name) SELECT event_name FROM "event_totals" WHERE total_spending <= total_budget ORDER BY purchases DESC, event_id ASC LIMIT 1

WITH "type_counts" AS (SELECT "e".type, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "member_count" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-09-01' AND "e".event_date < '2020-06-01' GROUP BY "e".type) SELECT type, member_count FROM "type_counts" WHERE member_count = (SELECT MAX(member_count) FROM "type_counts") LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".expense_description AS "item_name", COUNT(*) AS "record_count" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "e".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "b".category = 'Food' GROUP BY "e".expense_description ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, "e".expense_description ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT "b".category, "x".expense_description AS "item_name", SUM("x".cost) AS "total_cost" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "e".event_name = 'October Meeting' AND "x".approved = 'true' GROUP BY "b".category, "x".expense_description ORDER BY "b".category ASC, "x".expense_description ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name, "e".event_date, COALESCE((SELECT SUM("b".amount) FROM "budget" AS "b" WHERE "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id), 0) AS "total_amount_budgeted", (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) FROM "attendance" AS "a" WHERE "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id) AS "number_of_members_attended" FROM "event" AS "e" ORDER BY "e".event_name ASC, "e".event_date ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".expense_description AS "item_name", COUNT(*) AS "purchase_count" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id WHERE "m".first_name = 'Sacha' AND "m".last_name = 'Harrison' GROUP BY "e".expense_description ORDER BY "e".expense_description ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".first_name || ' ' || "m".last_name AS "full_name", COUNT(DISTINCT "e".expense_description) AS "different_kinds", SUM("e".cost) AS "total_spending_dollars" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "m".member_id = "e".link_to_member WHERE "e".expense_date >= '2019-10-01' AND "e".expense_date < '2019-12-01' GROUP BY "m".member_id, "m".first_name, "m".last_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "e".expense_description) = (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT expense_description) FROM "expense" WHERE expense_date >= '2019-10-01' AND expense_date < '2019-12-01' GROUP BY link_to_member ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT expense_description) DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY full_name ASC LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "ma".major_name) FROM "member" AS "me" INNER JOIN "major" AS "ma" ON "me".link_to_major = "ma".major_id WHERE "ma".department = 'Political Science Department' LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".colour AS "eye_colour", COUNT(*) AS "hero_count", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS "rank" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".eye_colour_id INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "c".colour <> 'No Colour' GROUP BY "c".colour ORDER BY hero_count DESC, eye_colour ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".superhero_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "s".id = "hp".hero_id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "hp".power_id = "sp".id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "sp".power_name = 'Super Strength' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".alignment = 'Neutral') / COUNT(*), 2) AS "neutral_percentage", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".alignment = 'Neutral' AND "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') AS "neutral_marvel_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) - 224 AS "difference" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' LIMIT 501
SELECT "s".superhero_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".eye_colour_id = "c".id WHERE "s".height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190 AND "c".colour = 'No Colour' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "s".height_cm BETWEEN 150 AND 180 AND "s".height_cm <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".full_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Strength' AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND "s".full_name <> '-' AND "ha".attribute_value = (SELECT MAX("ha2".attribute_value) FROM "hero_attribute" AS "ha2" INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a2" ON "a2".id = "ha2".attribute_id WHERE "a2".attribute_name = 'Strength') LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".superhero_name, "p".publisher_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "eye" ON "eye".id = "s".eye_colour_id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "hair" ON "hair".id = "s".hair_colour_id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "skin" ON "skin".id = "s".skin_colour_id LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "eye".colour NOT IN ('No Colour') AND "hair".colour NOT IN ('No Colour') AND "skin".colour NOT IN ('No Colour') AND "eye".colour = "hair".colour AND "hair".colour = "skin".colour AND "p".publisher_name IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("p".publisher_name) <> '' ORDER BY "s".superhero_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "skin_colour".colour = 'Blue') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" INNER JOIN "gender" ON "superhero".gender_id = "gender".id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "skin_colour" ON "superhero".skin_colour_id = "skin_colour".id WHERE "gender".gender = 'Female' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "g".gender = 'Female' LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "counts".dc_count = "counts".marvel_count THEN 'Tie' WHEN "counts".dc_count > "counts".marvel_count THEN 'DC Comics' ELSE 'Marvel Comics' END AS "publisher", ABS("counts".dc_count - "counts".marvel_count) AS "difference" FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics') AS "dc_count", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') AS "marvel_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id) AS "counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG("s".height_cm) AS "average_height_cm" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL AND "s".height_cm <> 0 AND "s".id IN (SELECT "hp".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" WHERE "hp".power_id NOT IN (SELECT "dhp".power_id FROM "superhero" AS "dc" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "dp" ON "dp".id = "dc".publisher_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "dhp" ON "dhp".hero_id = "dc".id WHERE "dp".publisher_name = 'DC Comics')) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM (SELECT "hp".power_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" GROUP BY "hp".power_id HAVING COUNT(*) = COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "hp".hero_id IN (SELECT "hp2".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp2" INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "ss" ON "ss".id = "hp2".power_id WHERE "ss".power_name = 'Super Strength')) AND BOOL_OR("hp".power_id IN (SELECT id FROM "superpower" WHERE power_name = 'Super Strength'))) AS "qualifying_powers" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".skin_colour_id = "c".id WHERE "c".colour ILIKE 'green' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id WHERE "a".alignment NOT IN ('Good', 'Bad') LIMIT 501

WITH "known_marvel_heroes" AS (SELECT "s".id FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "pub" ON "pub".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "pub".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("s".full_name) <> '' AND "s".full_name <> '-'), "power_counts" AS (SELECT "sp".power_name, COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".hero_id) AS "hero_count" FROM "known_marvel_heroes" AS "kmh" INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "kmh".id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id GROUP BY "sp".power_name) SELECT power_name, hero_count FROM "power_counts" WHERE hero_count = (SELECT MAX(hero_count) FROM "power_counts") ORDER BY power_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Intelligence' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 AND "ha".attribute_value = (SELECT "ha_ab".attribute_value FROM "superhero" AS "ab" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha_ab" ON "ha_ab".hero_id = "ab".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a_ab" ON "a_ab".id = "ha_ab".attribute_id WHERE "ab".superhero_name = 'Abomination' AND "a_ab".attribute_name = 'Intelligence') LIMIT 501

SELECT "g".gender, COUNT("q".id) AS "superhero_count" FROM "gender" AS "g" LEFT JOIN (SELECT "s".id, "s".gender_id FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".hair_colour_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "c".colour = 'Blue' GROUP BY "s".id, "s".gender_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".power_id) >= 10) AS "q" ON "q".gender_id = "g".id WHERE "g".gender IN ('Male', 'Female') GROUP BY "g".gender ORDER BY "g".gender ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg))::INTEGER AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Strength' AND "ha".attribute_value = (SELECT "hulk_ha".attribute_value FROM "superhero" AS "hulk" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "hulk_ha" ON "hulk_ha".hero_id = "hulk".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "hulk_a" ON "hulk_a".id = "hulk_ha".attribute_id WHERE "hulk".superhero_name = 'Hulk' AND "hulk_a".attribute_name = 'Strength') AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501

WITH "tallest" AS (SELECT id FROM "superhero" WHERE height_cm IS NOT NULL AND height_cm <> 0 ORDER BY height_cm DESC LIMIT 10), "cutoff" AS (SELECT MIN(height_cm) AS "height_cm" FROM "superhero" WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM "tallest")), "included_heroes" AS (SELECT "s".id FROM "superhero" AS "s" WHERE "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL AND "s".height_cm <> 0 AND "s".height_cm >= (SELECT height_cm FROM "cutoff")) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".power_id) FROM "included_heroes" AS "ih" INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "ih".id LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "superhero" AS "target" INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "abomb" ON "abomb"."superhero_name" = 'A-Bomb' INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "target"."publisher_id" = "p"."id" AND "abomb"."publisher_id" = "p"."id" LEFT JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "target"."race_id" = "r"."id" WHERE "r"."race" IS NULL OR "r"."race" = '-' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(power_count), 2) AS "average_superpowers_per_hero" FROM (SELECT "s".id, COUNT("hp".power_id) AS "power_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "s".race_id = "r".id INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id LEFT JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "r".race IN ('God', 'Eternal') AND "g".gender = 'Male' GROUP BY "s".id) AS "per_hero" LIMIT 501

WITH "cryokinesis_holders" AS (SELECT "hp".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "sp".power_name = 'Cryokinesis'), "related_heroes" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "hp".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" WHERE "hp".power_id IN (SELECT "hp2".power_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp2" INNER JOIN "cryokinesis_holders" AS "ch" ON "ch".hero_id = "hp2".hero_id)) SELECT ROUND(AVG(power_count)::NUMERIC, 1) FROM (SELECT "rh".hero_id, COUNT("hp".power_id) AS "power_count" FROM "related_heroes" AS "rh" INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "rh".hero_id GROUP BY "rh".hero_id) AS "per_hero" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("dc".weight_kg)) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "dc" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "dp" ON "dp".id = "dc".publisher_id INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "marvel" ON "marvel".eye_colour_id = "dc".eye_colour_id INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "mp" ON "mp".id = "marvel".publisher_id WHERE "dp".publisher_name = 'DC Comics' AND "mp".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "dc".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "dc".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".height_cm)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_height_cm" FROM "superhero" AS "a" INNER JOIN "race" AS "ar" ON "ar".id = "a".race_id INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "s" ON "s".race_id = "ar".id WHERE "a".superhero_name = 'A-Bomb' AND "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL AND "s".height_cm <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG("s".weight_kg) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "r".id = "s".race_id WHERE "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "superhero" AS "female_hero" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "g".id = "female_hero".gender_id WHERE "female_hero".race_id = "s".race_id AND "g".gender = 'Female') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "s".publisher_id) AS "publisher_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "s".height_cm > 200 AND "p".publisher_name IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("p".publisher_name) <> '' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "a".alignment = 'Good' AND "p".publisher_name <> 'DC Comics' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_weight_kg", COUNT(*) AS "superhero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "h".id) AS "count" FROM "superhero" AS "blackwulf" INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "h" ON "h".publisher_id = "blackwulf".publisher_id INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "other_hero" ON "other_hero".eye_colour_id = "h".eye_colour_id WHERE "blackwulf".superhero_name = 'Blackwulf' AND "other_hero".publisher_id IS NOT NULL AND "other_hero".publisher_id <> "h".publisher_id LIMIT 501

WITH "target_publisher" AS (SELECT publisher_id FROM "superhero" WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler'), "race_counts" AS (SELECT "r".race, COUNT(*) AS "superhero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "target_publisher" AS "tp" ON "s".publisher_id = "tp".publisher_id INNER JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "s".race_id = "r".id WHERE "r".race <> '-' GROUP BY "r".race) SELECT race, superhero_count FROM "race_counts" WHERE superhero_count = (SELECT MAX(superhero_count) FROM "race_counts") ORDER BY race ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg), 2) FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id WHERE "g".gender = 'Female' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("ha".attribute_value)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_intelligence_score" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Intelligence' AND "sp".power_name IN ('Super Speed', 'Death Touch') LIMIT 501

SELECT "g".gender, ROUND(AVG(COALESCE("p".power_count, 0)::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_superpowers_per_hero" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "g".id = "s".gender_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT "hp".hero_id, COUNT(*) AS "power_count" FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" GROUP BY "hp".hero_id) AS "p" ON "p".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "g".gender IN ('Male', 'Female') AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("s".full_name) <> '' AND "s".full_name <> '-' AND "s".full_name ~ '^[^[:space:]]+([[:space:]]+[^[:space:]]+)+$' GROUP BY "g".gender ORDER BY "g".gender ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".height_cm) FILTER (WHERE "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL AND "s".height_cm <> 0)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_height_cm", ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg) FILTER (WHERE "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".skin_colour_id WHERE "a".alignment = 'Bad' AND "c".colour = 'Green' LIMIT 501

SELECT (SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".height_cm)::NUMERIC, 1) FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'George Lucas' AND "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL AND "s".height_cm <> 0) AS "average_height_cm", (SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 1) FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'George Lucas' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0) AS "average_weight_kg" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".height_cm)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_height_cm" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp3" ON "hp3".power_id = "hp".power_id INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "s3" ON "s3".id = "hp3".hero_id WHERE "s3".superhero_name = '3-D Man' AND "s".id <> "s3".id AND "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL AND "s".height_cm <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".skin_colour_id INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "p" ON "p".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "c".colour = 'Green' AND "a".alignment = 'Bad' AND "p".power_name = 'Flight' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 2) FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT hero_id FROM "hero_power") AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'George Lucas' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "g".id = "s".gender_id INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id WHERE "g".gender = 'Female' AND "a".alignment = 'Good' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".power_id) AS "power_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "g".id = "s".gender_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "g".gender = 'Male' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 AND "s".weight_kg < 70 LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".colour FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "s".race_id = "r".id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".hair_colour_id = "c".id WHERE "r".race = 'Human' AND "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL AND "s".height_cm <> 0 ORDER BY "s".height_cm ASC LIMIT 1

WITH "lightest" AS (SELECT MIN(weight_kg) AS "weight_kg" FROM "superhero" WHERE weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND weight_kg <> 0), "power_counts" AS (SELECT "s".id, COUNT(DISTINCT "sp".power_name) AS "power_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" CROSS JOIN "lightest" AS "l" LEFT JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id LEFT JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "s".weight_kg = "l".weight_kg GROUP BY "s".id) SELECT COALESCE(MAX(power_count), 0) FROM "power_counts" LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id WHERE "a".alignment = 'Neutral' AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND "s".full_name <> '-' LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".superhero_name, "s".full_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Speed' AND "ha".attribute_value = (SELECT MAX("ha2".attribute_value) FROM "hero_attribute" AS "ha2" INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a2" ON "a2".id = "ha2".attribute_id WHERE "a2".attribute_name = 'Speed') AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("s".full_name) <> '' AND "s".full_name <> '-' ORDER BY "s".superhero_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "eye_colour".colour AS "eye_colour", COUNT(*) AS "hero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "eye_colour" ON "s".eye_colour_id = "eye_colour".id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "hair_colour" ON "s".hair_colour_id = "hair_colour".id WHERE "eye_colour".colour IN (SELECT "eye_colour_brown".colour FROM "superhero" AS "brown_hero" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "eye_colour_brown" ON "brown_hero".eye_colour_id = "eye_colour_brown".id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "brown_hair" ON "brown_hero".hair_colour_id = "brown_hair".id WHERE "brown_hair".colour = 'Brown') AND "hair_colour".colour <> 'Brown' GROUP BY "eye_colour".colour ORDER BY hero_count DESC, "eye_colour".colour ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".alignment = 'Good') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id LEFT JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("s".full_name) <> '' AND "s".full_name <> '-' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".alignment = 'Good' THEN "s".id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "s".id), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 2) FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "hp".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "target_hp" ON "hp".power_id = "target_hp".power_id INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "target" ON "target".id = "target_hp".hero_id WHERE "target".superhero_name = '3-D Man') AS "shared" ON "shared".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "s".superhero_name <> '3-D Man' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "c".colour = 'No Colour') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "c".colour ILIKE 'blue') AS "difference" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".eye_colour_id = "c".id WHERE "s".weight_kg IS NULL OR "s".weight_kg = 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'M' AND "l".ua > 8.0 THEN "p".id END)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".ua > 6.5 THEN "p".id END), 0) AS "male_to_female_ratio" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE ("p".sex = 'M' AND "l".ua > 8.0) OR ("p".sex = 'F' AND "l".ua > 6.5) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("l".alb)::NUMERIC, 4) AS "average_alb" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".plt > 400 AND "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "l".alb IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".tg >= 200 AND "p".birthday < DATE '1976-10-09' LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, "p".sex, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday)) AS "completed_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".glu >= 180 AND "l"."T-CHO" < 250 LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday)) AS "completed_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".hct >= 52) >= 2 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' THEN "p".id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id), 0), 2) AS "female_percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday < DATE '1971-10-09' AND "l".date = DATE '2026-10-09' AND "l".pt >= 14 LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".crp LIKE '%+%' AND "p".description IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".sc170 IN ('negative', '0') AND "p".id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM "examination" WHERE symptoms IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".admission = '+') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS "inpatient_percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory") AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday >= DATE '1930-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1941-01-01' LIMIT 501
