WITH "strongest" AS (SELECT MAX("rnp"::NUMERIC) AS "max_rnp" FROM "laboratory" WHERE "rnp" IS NOT NULL AND "rnp" <> 'negative'), "candidates" AS (SELECT "l"."T-BIL" AS "total_bilirubin", "l"."date", "l"."id", "p"."sex", "p"."birthday" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p"."id" = "l"."id" CROSS JOIN "strongest" AS "s" WHERE "l"."rnp" IS NOT NULL AND "l"."rnp" <> 'negative' AND "l"."rnp"::NUMERIC = "s".max_rnp AND "l"."T-BIL" IS NOT NULL), "highest" AS (SELECT MAX(total_bilirubin) AS "max_bilirubin" FROM "candidates") SELECT "c".total_bilirubin, "c"."date", "c"."id", "c"."sex", "c"."birthday" FROM "candidates" AS "c" CROSS JOIN "highest" AS "h" WHERE "c".total_bilirubin = "h".max_bilirubin LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id AND "e".thrombosis <> 0 LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id AND "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::NUMERIC > 10 WHERE "p".birthday > DATE '1960-01-01' AND "l".id IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, "l".rnp FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "s" ON "s".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' AND "s".ssa IS NOT NULL AND "s".ssa NOT IN ('negative', '0') AND "l".rnp::INTEGER = (SELECT MAX("r".rnp::INTEGER) FROM "patient" AS "p2" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "r" ON "r".id = "p2".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "s2" ON "s2".id = "p2".id WHERE "p2".admission = '-' AND "r".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "r".rnp <> 'negative' AND "s2".ssa IS NOT NULL AND "s2".ssa NOT IN ('negative', '0')) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "plt" ON "plt".id = "p".id AND "plt".plt BETWEEN 100 AND 400 INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "rnp" ON "rnp".id = "p".id AND "rnp".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' AND "rnp".rnp::NUMERIC > 5 WHERE "p".diagnosis = 'MCTD' LIMIT 501

SELECT sex, ROUND(AVG(test_date_count)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_laboratory_test_dates" FROM (SELECT "p".id, "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "l".date) AS "test_date_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".id = "p".id) GROUP BY "p".id, "p".sex) AS "patient_counts" GROUP BY sex LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "l".id, "l".date, "l".dna::NUMERIC AS "anti_dna_level" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".admission = '+' AND "l".dna IS NOT NULL), "ranked" AS (SELECT id, date, anti_dna_level, MAX(anti_dna_level) OVER (PARTITION BY id) AS "highest_level" FROM "eligible") SELECT id, date, anti_dna_level FROM "ranked" WHERE anti_dna_level = highest_level ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".admission AS "care_setting", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER > 16 AND "p".admission IN ('+', '-') GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY "p".admission ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "h" ON "h".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "r" ON "r".id = "p".id WHERE "h".hct IS NOT NULL AND ("h".hct <= 29 OR "h".hct >= 52) AND "r".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "r".rnp <> 'negative' AND "r".rnp::NUMERIC > 16 GROUP BY "p".id) AS "qualifying_patients" LIMIT 501
SELECT MAX("rnp"::INTEGER) AS "highest_anti_rnp_value" FROM "laboratory" WHERE "rnp" IS NOT NULL AND "rnp" <> 'negative' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "n".id IS NOT NULL) AS "patients_with_normal_platelet_result", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "n".id IS NULL) AS "patients_never_with_normal_platelet_result" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "l".id FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".plt > 100 AND "l".plt < 400) AS "n" ON "n".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis IN ('MRA, SJS', 'SJS, MRA') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("l".tp - 8.5)::NUMERIC, 3) AS "average_deviation" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".tp > 8.5 AND "e".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE birthday >= DATE '1960-01-01') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis IN ('Psoriatic arthritis', 'Psoriatic Arthritis') LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".alb < 3.5 AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "l"."rnp" <> 'negative' AND "l"."rnp"::INTEGER > 64) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F') AS "women" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "women".id WHERE "l"."rnp" IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG(1999 - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p".birthday)) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE "U-PRO" IN ('3', '4', '300', '>=300', '>=1000')) AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER > 32 AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex LIMIT 501

SELECT MIN(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "l".date)::INTEGER - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p".birthday)::INTEGER) AS "youngest_age_years" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' AND "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER >= 64 LIMIT 501

SELECT SUM(laboratory_count)::BIGINT AS "total_laboratory_tests", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE laboratory_count = 0) AS "patients_with_no_laboratory_tests" FROM (SELECT "p".id, COUNT("l".id) AS "laboratory_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis IN ('Psoriatic arthritis', 'Psoriatic Arthritis') GROUP BY "p".id) AS "patient_laboratory_counts" LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "e".id) FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e"."Examination Date" >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND "e"."Examination Date" < DATE '1998-01-01' AND "e".thrombosis > 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".symptoms FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "e".thrombosis > 0 AND "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "e".symptoms IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "e".symptoms ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, "e".symptoms ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "examination" WHERE thrombosis > 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(("first_exam".first_examination_date - "p"."First Date")::NUMERIC)) AS "average_delay_days" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN LATERAL (SELECT MIN("e"."Examination Date") AS "first_examination_date" FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".id = "p".id AND "e"."Examination Date" IS NOT NULL) AS "first_exam" ON TRUE WHERE "p".admission LIKE '%+%' AND "p"."First Date" IS NOT NULL AND "first_exam".first_examination_date IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".date >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1995-01-01' AND "l".got < 60 AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "qualifying_patients" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "l".id FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".ldh > 600 AND "l".ldh < 800 AND ("l"."U-PRO" IN ('300', '>=300', '>=1000') OR "l"."U-PRO" ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l"."U-PRO"::NUMERIC >= 300)) SELECT "p".id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday))::INTEGER AS "completed_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "qualifying_patients" AS "q" ON "q".id = "p".id LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'M') AS "difference" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".diagnosis = 'RA' AND "l".un < 30 LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l".cre >= 1.5 THEN "p".id END) AS "patients_with_out_of_range_creatinine", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "total_patients", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l".cre >= 1.5 THEN "p".id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id), 0), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('M', 'F') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "l"."T-CHO", "p".admission, "l".id FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') AND "l"."T-CHO" IS NOT NULL AND ("p".admission, "l"."T-CHO") IN (SELECT "p2".admission, MAX("l2"."T-CHO") FROM "laboratory" AS "l2" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p2" ON "p2".id = "l2".id WHERE "p2".admission IN ('+', '-') AND "l2"."T-CHO" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "p2".admission) ORDER BY CASE "p".admission WHEN '+' THEN 1 WHEN '-' THEN 2 END ASC, "l".id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible_patients" AS (SELECT id FROM "patient" WHERE "First Date" >= DATE '1991-01-01' AND "First Date" < DATE '1992-01-01'), "recorded" AS (SELECT "l".id, "l".rnp::INTEGER AS "anti_rnp_level" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "eligible_patients" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative') SELECT id, anti_rnp_level FROM "recorded" WHERE anti_rnp_level = (SELECT MAX(anti_rnp_level) FROM "recorded") LIMIT 501
SELECT AVG(hct) FROM "laboratory" WHERE date >= DATE '1991-01-01' AND date < DATE '1992-01-01' AND hct IS NOT NULL AND "U-PRO" IN ('300', '>=300', '>=1000') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".rf IN ('-', '+-') AND "l".date = (SELECT MAX("l2".date) FROM "laboratory" AS "l2" WHERE "l2".id = "p".id) LIMIT 501

WITH "latest_lab" AS (SELECT id, MAX(date) AS "latest_date" FROM "laboratory" GROUP BY id), "latest_scl" AS (SELECT id, date, sc170 FROM (SELECT id, date, sc170, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY id ORDER BY date DESC) AS "rn" FROM "laboratory" WHERE sc170 IS NOT NULL) AS "ranked" WHERE rn = 1) SELECT "l".id FROM "latest_lab" AS "l" INNER JOIN "latest_scl" AS "s" ON "s".id = "l".id WHERE "l".latest_date > DATE '1997-01-01' AND "s".sc170 IN ('negative', '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM (SELECT id FROM "laboratory" GROUP BY id HAVING BOOL_OR(ssa IS NOT NULL AND ssa <> 'negative' AND ssa <> '0') AND BOOL_OR("U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND "U-PRO" NOT IN ('-', '0'))) AS "patients" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "p".id FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".dna IS NOT NULL AND "l".dna::REAL < 8) AS "qualifying_patients" LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".admission = '+' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".alp >= 300) LIMIT 501
SELECT MAX(CAST("l".rnp AS INTEGER)) FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".cre < 1.5 AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' THEN 'female' WHEN "p".sex = 'M' THEN 'male' END AS "sex", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND "l".hgb < 7.0 GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, "l".date, "l".rnp FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".got >= 60 AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER = (SELECT MAX(rnp::INTEGER) FROM "laboratory" WHERE got >= 60 AND rnp IS NOT NULL AND rnp <> 'negative') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday > DATE '1980-01-01' AND ("l".fg < 150 OR "l".fg > 450 OR "l"."U-PRO" IN ('3', '4', '300', '>=300', '>=1000')) LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "p".admission = '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital' ELSE 'followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "patient_group", COUNT(*) AS "normal_ldh_measurements" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') AND "l".ldh < 500 GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY CASE WHEN "p".admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE has_lab) AS "patients_with_laboratory_result", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE has_elevated_t_bil) AS "patients_with_elevated_total_bilirubin" FROM (SELECT "p".id, BOOL_OR("l".id IS NOT NULL) AS "has_lab", BOOL_OR("l"."T-BIL" >= 2.0) AS "has_elevated_t_bil" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IS NULL OR "p".sex = '' GROUP BY "p".id) AS "patient_lab_summary" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".admission ILIKE '+%' AND "p".birthday >= DATE '1945-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1990-01-01' AND "e"."ANA Pattern" = 'P' LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "anemia" ON "anemia".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "anemia".hgb < 10 GROUP BY "p".id), "patient_rnp" AS (SELECT "l".id, MAX("l".rnp::INTEGER) AS "highest_rnp" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "eligible" AS "e" ON "e".id = "l".id WHERE "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' GROUP BY "l".id), "overall" AS (SELECT MAX(highest_rnp) AS "highest_rnp" FROM "patient_rnp") SELECT "pr".id, "p".sex, "pr".highest_rnp FROM "patient_rnp" AS "pr" INNER JOIN "overall" AS "o" ON "pr".highest_rnp = "o".highest_rnp INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "pr".id LIMIT 501

WITH "first_labs" AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (id) id, got, rnp FROM "laboratory" WHERE date IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id ASC, date ASC) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "first_labs" WHERE got < 60 AND rnp IS NOT NULL AND rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND rnp::NUMERIC > 10 LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, "p".sex, "l".date, "l"."U-PRO" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT id, MAX(date) AS "latest_date" FROM "laboratory" WHERE "U-PRO" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY id) AS "latest" ON "latest".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "latest".id AND "l".date = "latest".latest_date WHERE "l"."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::NUMERIC > 0 AND "e".thrombosis = 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".birthday FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT "l".id, MAX("l".gpt) AS "highest_normal_gpt" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::NUMERIC >= 16 AND "l".gpt < 60 GROUP BY "l".id) AS "qualified" ON "qualified".id = "p".id ORDER BY "qualified".highest_normal_gpt DESC, "p".id ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "e".thrombosis = 1 AND "l".pt < 14 AND "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER >= 16 LIMIT 501

SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE("l"."date", "p"."birthday"))::INTEGER AS "age", "p"."diagnosis" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p"."id" = "l"."id" WHERE "p"."admission" = '+' AND "l"."dna" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "l"."dna"::NUMERIC DESC, "l"."date" ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, "p".sex FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l"."T-BIL" >= 1.2 AND "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "p".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%SLE susp%' ORDER BY "p".sex ASC, "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "p".id, CASE WHEN "p".admission = '+' THEN 'Admitted to the hospital' ELSE 'Followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "care_setting" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".birthday <= DATE '1976-10-09' AND "p".admission IN ('+', '-')), "patient_outcomes" AS (SELECT "e".id, "e".care_setting, BOOL_OR("l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::NUMERIC >= 4) AS "has_elevated_rnp" FROM "eligible" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "e".id GROUP BY "e".id, "e".care_setting) SELECT care_setting, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE has_elevated_rnp) AS "patients_with_at_least_one_result_ge_4", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT has_elevated_rnp) AS "patients_with_no_such_result" FROM "patient_outcomes" GROUP BY care_setting ORDER BY care_setting ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "latest_igg" AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON ("l".id) "l".id, "l".date, "l".igg FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".igg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "l".id ASC, "l".date DESC) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "latest_igg" AS "li" ON "li".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "li".igg >= 2000 LIMIT 501

WITH "sle_patients" AS (SELECT id, diagnosis FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%'), "highest" AS (SELECT MAX("l".dna::NUMERIC) AS "max_dna" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "sle_patients" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".dna IS NOT NULL) SELECT "p".id, "p".diagnosis, "l".dna FROM "sle_patients" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id CROSS JOIN "highest" AS "h" WHERE "l".dna::NUMERIC = "h".max_dna LIMIT 501

WITH "settings" AS (SELECT "p".id, CASE WHEN "p".admission IN ('+', '+(') THEN 'admitted to the hospital' WHEN "p".admission = '-' THEN 'followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "care_setting" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '+(', '-')), "latest_igg" AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON ("l".id) "l".id, "l".igg FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".igg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "l".id ASC, "l".date DESC) SELECT "s".care_setting, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "li".igg > 900 AND "li".igg < 2000) / COUNT(*), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "settings" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "latest_igg" AS "li" ON "li".id = "s".id GROUP BY "s".care_setting ORDER BY "s".care_setting ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "latest" AS (SELECT id, MAX(date) AS "max_date" FROM "laboratory" GROUP BY id), "latest_results" AS (SELECT "l".id, "l".rnp FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "latest" AS "x" ON "l".id = "x".id AND "l".date = "x".max_date) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') - COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'M') AS "female_minus_male" FROM "latest_results" AS "r" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "r".id WHERE "r".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "r".rnp::INTEGER >= 32 LIMIT 501

WITH "ranked_labs" AS (SELECT "l".id, "l".date, "l".rnp, "l".cpk, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "l".id ORDER BY "l".date DESC) AS "rn" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F') SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "ranked_labs" WHERE rn = 1 AND rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND rnp::INTEGER > 64 AND cpk < 250 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE admission = '+') AS "inpatients", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE admission = '-') AS "outpatients", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE admission = '+') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE admission IN ('+', '-')), 0), 2) AS "inpatient_percentage" FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis ~ '(^|[, ])SLE([, ]|$)' LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, "p".sex, "p".birthday FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE ldh >= 500 GROUP BY id) AS "ldh_patients" ON "ldh_patients".id = "p".id INNER JOIN (SELECT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE "U-PRO" IN ('100', '300', '>=300', '>=1000', '+2(100)', '+1(300)', '+2(300)') OR ("U-PRO" ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "U-PRO"::INTEGER >= 100) OR "U-PRO" LIKE '%(100)%' OR "U-PRO" LIKE '%(300)%' OR "U-PRO" LIKE '%(1000)%' OR "U-PRO" LIKE '>=1%' OR "U-PRO" LIKE '>=3%' GROUP BY id) AS "protein_patients" ON "protein_patients".id = "p".id ORDER BY "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".id = "p".id) GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" WHERE sex = 'F' AND "First Date" >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND "First Date" < DATE '1999-01-01' AND admission LIKE '+%' LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".symptoms, "p".diagnosis FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "e".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "e".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%SLE susp%' AND "e".symptoms IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "p".birthday DESC, "p".id ASC, "e"."Examination Date" DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT "p".diagnosis FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".admission LIKE '+%' AND "p"."First Date" >= DATE '1998-02-15' AND "p"."First Date" < DATE '1998-03-01' AND "p".birthday IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "p".birthday ASC, "p".id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(AVG("aCL IgM")::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_acl_igm" FROM "examination" WHERE "Examination Date" >= DATE '1993-10-01' AND "Examination Date" < DATE '1993-11-01' AND diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "aCL IgM" IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis ILIKE '%psoriatic arthritis%' LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex IN ('M', 'F') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".gpt >= 60) GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".admission, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count", ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday))), 1) AS "average_completed_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".rbc < 3.5 AND "p".admission IN ('+', '-') GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY "p".admission ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "patient".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "patient".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" INNER JOIN "laboratory" ON "laboratory".id = "patient".id WHERE "patient".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "patient".sex ORDER BY CASE "patient".sex WHEN 'F' THEN 1 WHEN 'M' THEN 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("e"."aCL IgM")::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_acl_igm" FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SJS%' AND "p".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%SJS susp%' AND "e"."aCL IgM" IS NOT NULL AND "e"."aCL IgM" <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "e".diagnosis ILIKE '%SjS%' AND "e".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%susp%' LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".rnp IN ('negative', '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "lp" ON "lp".id = "p".id WHERE "l".sm IN ('negative', '0') AND "e".thrombosis = 0 AND "lp"."U-PRO" IN ('30', '100', '300', '>=300', '>=1000', '+1(30)', '+2(100)') LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rbc <= 3.5 OR rbc >= 6.0) AS "abnormal" ON "abnormal".id = "p".id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp IS NOT NULL AND rnp <> 'negative' AND rnp::NUMERIC > 0) AS "positive" ON "positive".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' ORDER BY "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT TO_CHAR(AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday))), 'FM999999990.0') AS "average_age_years" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday IS NOT NULL AND AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday) < INTERVAL '70 years' AND "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::NUMERIC >= 64 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M')), 0), 1) AS "women_percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".birthday >= DATE '1936-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1957-01-01' AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".cpk >= 250) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".date >= DATE '1981-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1987-01-01' AND "p".birthday IS NOT NULL AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age("l".date, "p".birthday)) < 50 AND "l".plt BETWEEN 100 AND 400 AND "l"."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND "l"."U-PRO" NOT IN ('-', '0', '%%') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(oxygen_count), 4) AS "average_oxygen_atoms_per_molecule" FROM (SELECT "m".molecule_id, COUNT("a".atom_id) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'o') AS "oxygen_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" LEFT JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM "bond" WHERE bond_type = '-') AS "single_bond_molecules" ON "single_bond_molecules".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id GROUP BY "m".molecule_id) AS "molecule_oxygen_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG(single_bond_count) FROM (SELECT "b".molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS "single_bond_count" FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "b".bond_type = '-' GROUP BY "b".molecule_id) AS "per_molecule" LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' GROUP BY "a".element HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MIN(element_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "element_count" FROM "atom" AS "a2" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m2" ON "a2".molecule_id = "m2".molecule_id WHERE "m2".label = '-' GROUP BY "a2".element) AS "counts") LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 'i' THEN "a".atom_id END) AS "iodine_atoms", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 's' THEN "a".atom_id END) AS "sulfur_atoms" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '-' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id AND "a".element = 'f')) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage_no_fluorine" FROM "molecule" AS "m" WHERE "m".label = '+' LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_type, CASE WHEN "m".label = '+' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS "carcinogenic" FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id WHERE "b".molecule_id = 'TR010' GROUP BY "b".bond_type, "m".label ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT "b".bond_id, "b".bond_type FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE ("a1".element = 'p' AND "a2".element = 'n') OR ("a1".element = 'n' AND "a2".element = 'p') LIMIT 501
SELECT DISTINCT "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "connected" AS "c" WHERE "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "a".atom_id) AS "atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a".molecule_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT "b".molecule_id FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "p" ON "p".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '#' AND "p".element IN ('p', 'br')) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'cl') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS "percentage_chlorine_atoms" FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a".molecule_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT "b".molecule_id FROM "bond" AS "b" WHERE "b".bond_type = '-') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'h')::NUMERIC / COUNT(*) AS "hydrogen_fraction", "m".label AS "carcinogenicity_label" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id WHERE "a".molecule_id = 'TR006' GROUP BY "m".label LIMIT 501

WITH "bond_groups" AS (SELECT "m".molecule_id, "m".label, CASE WHEN COUNT("b".bond_id) > 0 AND BOOL_AND("b".bond_type = '-') THEN 'all_single' ELSE 'not_all_single' END AS "saturation_group" FROM "molecule" AS "m" LEFT JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id GROUP BY "m".molecule_id, "m".label), "counts" AS (SELECT saturation_group, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE label = '+') AS "carcinogenic_count", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE label = '-') AS "non_carcinogenic_count" FROM "bond_groups" GROUP BY saturation_group) SELECT saturation_group, carcinogenic_count - non_carcinogenic_count AS "difference" FROM "counts" ORDER BY CASE saturation_group WHEN 'all_single' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b"."molecule_id" = "m"."molecule_id" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c"."bond_id" = "b"."bond_id" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1"."atom_id" = "c"."atom_id" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2"."atom_id" = "c"."atom_id2" WHERE "m"."label" = '+' AND "b"."bond_type" = '=' AND "a1"."element" = 'c' AND "a2"."element" = 'c' LIMIT 501

WITH "plus_molecules" AS (SELECT molecule_id FROM "molecule" WHERE label = '+'), "bonded_atoms" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "a".atom_id, "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "plus_molecules" AS "p" ON "p".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id), "element_counts" AS (SELECT element, COUNT(*) AS "bonded_atom_count" FROM "bonded_atoms" GROUP BY element), "all_plus_atoms" AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "total_atoms" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "plus_molecules" AS "p" ON "p".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id), "ranked" AS (SELECT element, bonded_atom_count, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY bonded_atom_count DESC) AS "rnk" FROM "element_counts") SELECT "r".element, ROUND(100.0 * "r".bonded_atom_count / "t".total_atoms, 2) AS "percentage_of_all_plus_atoms" FROM "ranked" AS "r" CROSS JOIN "all_plus_atoms" AS "t" WHERE "r".rnk = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".molecule_id, CASE WHEN "m".label = '+' THEN 'YES' WHEN "m".label = '-' THEN 'NO' END AS "carcinogenic", COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) FILTER (WHERE "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) AS "multiple_bonds" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "a".atom_id = 'TR041_10' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id, "m".label LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_type, COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a1".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 AND "a2".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id AND "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "a1".element = 'c' AND "a2".element = 'c' AND "b".bond_type IN ('-', '=', '#') GROUP BY "b".bond_type ORDER BY CASE "b".bond_type WHEN '-' THEN 1 WHEN '=' THEN 2 WHEN '#' THEN 3 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c".atom_id2) AS "count" FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "chlorine" ON "chlorine".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "bonded" ON "bonded".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "chlorine".element = 'cl' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c".atom_id2) FROM "atom" AS "s" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "s".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "s".atom_id WHERE "s".element = 's' AND "m".label = '+' LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "b".bond_id, "b".molecule_id FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "b".molecule_id IN (SELECT "a".molecule_id FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a".element NOT IN (SELECT "other_a".element FROM "atom" AS "other_a" WHERE "other_a".molecule_id <> "a".molecule_id)) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "n".molecule_id) AS "molecule_count" FROM "atom" AS "n" LEFT JOIN (SELECT "a".molecule_id FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id WHERE "a".element = 'n' AND "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) AS "disqualified" ON "disqualified".molecule_id = "n".molecule_id WHERE "n".element = 'n' AND "disqualified".molecule_id IS NULL LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c".atom_id2) FROM "atom" AS "chlorine" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "chlorine".atom_id WHERE "chlorine".element = 'cl' LIMIT 501

WITH "triple_bond_molecules" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "b".molecule_id FROM "bond" AS "b" WHERE "b".bond_type = '#'), "labeled" AS (SELECT "m".label FROM "triple_bond_molecules" AS "t" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "t".molecule_id WHERE "m".label IN ('+', '-')), "counts" AS (SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE label = '+') AS "carcinogenic_count", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE label = '-') AS "non_carcinogenic_count", COUNT(*) AS "total_count" FROM "labeled") SELECT ROUND(100.0 * carcinogenic_count / total_count, 2) AS "carcinogenic_percent", ROUND(100.0 * non_carcinogenic_count / total_count, 2) AS "non_carcinogenic_percent" FROM "counts" LIMIT 501

WITH "rare_elements" AS (SELECT "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" GROUP BY "a".element HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "a".molecule_id) = 1), "qualifying_molecules" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "a".molecule_id FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "rare_elements" AS "r" ON "r".element = "a".element INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+'), "atom_bond_counts" AS (SELECT "a".molecule_id, "a".atom_id, COUNT("c".bond_id) AS "bond_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "rare_elements" AS "r" ON "r".element = "a".element LEFT JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id GROUP BY "a".molecule_id, "a".atom_id) SELECT "q".molecule_id, SUM("ab".bond_count) AS "bond_count" FROM "qualifying_molecules" AS "q" INNER JOIN "atom_bond_counts" AS "ab" ON "ab".molecule_id = "q".molecule_id GROUP BY "q".molecule_id ORDER BY "q".molecule_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "atom_counts" AS (SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS "atom_count", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE element = 'c') AS "carbon_atom_count", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE element = 'cl') AS "chlorine_atom_count" FROM "atom" GROUP BY molecule_id), "bond_counts" AS (SELECT "per_bond".molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS "bond_count", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "per_bond".carbon_touching) AS "carbon_touching_bond_count", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "per_bond".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) AS "multiple_bond_count" FROM (SELECT "b".bond_id, "b".molecule_id, "b".bond_type, BOOL_OR("a".element = 'c') AS "carbon_touching" FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id OR "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 GROUP BY "b".bond_id, "b".molecule_id, "b".bond_type) AS "per_bond" GROUP BY "per_bond".molecule_id), "ranked" AS (SELECT "m".molecule_id, "m".label, "ac".atom_count, COALESCE("bc".bond_count, 0) AS "bond_count", "ac".carbon_atom_count, "ac".chlorine_atom_count, COALESCE("bc".carbon_touching_bond_count, 0) AS "carbon_touching_bond_count", COALESCE("bc".multiple_bond_count, 0) AS "multiple_bond_count", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE("bc".carbon_touching_bond_count, 0) DESC, "ac".atom_count DESC, "m".molecule_id ASC) AS "rank" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom_counts" AS "ac" ON "ac".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "bond_counts" AS "bc" ON "bc".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "ac".carbon_atom_count > 0) SELECT molecule_id, label, atom_count, bond_count, carbon_atom_count, chlorine_atom_count, carbon_touching_bond_count, multiple_bond_count, rank FROM "ranked" ORDER BY rank ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "bond_count" FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "c".atom_id = "a1".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "c".atom_id2 = "a2".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id WHERE "a1".molecule_id = (SELECT molecule_id FROM "atom" WHERE element = 'y' LIMIT 1) AND ("a1".element = 'h' OR "a2".element = 'h') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(atom_bond_count), 2) AS "average_bonds_per_atom" FROM (SELECT "a".atom_id, COUNT("c".bond_id) AS "atom_bond_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" LEFT JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id WHERE "a".molecule_id = 'TR397' GROUP BY "a".atom_id) AS "atom_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT "a2".element, COUNT(*) AS "bond_count" FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "c".atom_id = "a1".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "c".atom_id2 = "a2".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' AND "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#') AND "a1".element = 'c' GROUP BY "a2".element ORDER BY "a2".element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_type AS "bond_kind", COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) AS "bond_count", COUNT(DISTINCT (LEAST("a1".element, "a2".element), GREATEST("a1".element, "a2".element))) AS "element_pair_count", "m".label AS "carcinogenicity_label" FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "b".molecule_id = 'TR377' AND "b".bond_type IN ('-', '=') GROUP BY "b".bond_type, "m".label ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) DESC, "b".bond_type ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".molecule_id FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' AND "a".element IN ('na', 'k', 'ca', 'cu', 'zn', 'sn', 'pb') AND "b".bond_type = '-' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id ORDER BY "m".molecule_id ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(*) AS "atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN (SELECT "c".atom_id AS "atom_id" FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id GROUP BY "c".atom_id HAVING BOOL_OR("b".bond_type = '-') AND BOOL_AND("b".bond_type = '-') UNION ALL SELECT "c".atom_id2 AS "atom_id" FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id GROUP BY "c".atom_id2 HAVING BOOL_OR("b".bond_type = '-') AND BOOL_AND("b".bond_type = '-')) AS "bonded_single" ON "bonded_single".atom_id = "a".atom_id WHERE "a".element <> 'na' GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY "a".element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".molecule_id) AS "molecule_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '#' GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY molecule_count DESC, "a".element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".atom_id) AS "atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id WHERE "a".molecule_id = 'TR397' GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY "a".element ASC LIMIT 501
